title: Chapter 291: New Three-Star Mission
html:
“I missed the only chance to save her.”

Master Bai kept his head bowed as he spoke, every word steeped in guilt and regret. After a long pause, he continued.

“I visited them again after one month to see whether they had found the girl. I knocked on the door for a long time, but there was no answer.

“I went around the hut and found the window shattered. Standing on tiptoe, I looked inside. The girl’s mother lay collapsed beneath it, one hand gripping the sill. She appeared to have tried escaping, but the room had been built like a prison, and the opening was too small for her body.

“I smashed the door’s lock with my hoe. The father had built the hut sturdily; it took several blows before the door gave way. A faint stench hung inside, and every table and chair had been overturned. The father lay beside the door, which bore deep marks from his fingernails. He must have suffered terribly.

“I called the police and an ambulance. Just as I prepared to run to the village for help, the neighboring hut opened. The Zhu family’s younger daughter calmly walked outside.

“Seeing the key in her pocket, I was reminded of the fact that the door was locked from the outside!

“The orchard was too isolated for strangers to visit, and the villagers avoided the family. No outsider would poison the parents and lock them inside without a reason. Only one possibility remained: the younger daughter had done it.

“As I looked at her, she suddenly seemed like a stranger. Perhaps she saw her own future in her sister and acted to protect herself. After all, the younger girl had also been born with a less visible abnormality.

“Then something even more frightening happened. When she saw me, she showed neither panic nor fear. She approached as calmly as ever. Her beautiful face looked utterly innocent, but the words she spoke still chill me today.

“In a flat, emotionless voice, she told me that her sister had been buried in the orchard several weeks earlier and asked me to help find her. I tried to explain that anyone buried beneath the earth was already dead. She merely smiled and said that after death, people became something else—and that her sister had never truly left.”

Master Bai clasped his hands tightly, cold sweat breaking across his forehead at the memory. “I didn’t know how to respond. I ran back to the village and brought several young men to guard the orchard until the police arrived.

“A lengthy investigation followed. I told the police a body might be buried in the orchard, but they could not find Zhu Xinrou. They tried questioning the little girl, but she refused to speak, as though she had become mute overnight.

“Because I felt guilty about abandoning Zhu Xinrou, I did not accuse her sister. Besides, in my eyes, their parents received what they deserved.”

There was a bitterness in the old man’s voice.

“They continually beat their daughters, and when the refugees from Coffin Village wanted Zhu Xinrou executed, her parents did nothing to stop them. They tacitly approved. If the original residents of Bai Family Village had not intervened, the tragedy would have occurred years earlier.”

“Other than the little girl, you’re the biggest suspect, right? Didn’t the police say anything to you?” Chen Ge was calm; the case was as he expected.

“I tried to protect the girl, but the police were not easily misled. They reconstructed much of the truth from tiny clues. One officer named Yan appeared to understand everything, though he never said so outright.”

The old man looked at the coffin and reminisced about the past.

“He seemed less interested in the poisoning than in Coffin Village. After I gave my statement, they released me.

“The girl was taken away by the police, and I moved to the city to live with my son. However, whenever night came, I could hear Zhu Xinrou’s voice crying, ‘Save me, save me.’

“My son and daughter-in-law heard nothing. But my grandson, who had just started kindergarten, would point beneath his bed or into the wardrobe and shout, ‘Spider! Spider!’

“We searched the entire house without finding a spider. Suspecting Zhu Xinrou’s involvement, I bought the orchard and moved here. My purpose is to find her body. I’m an old man with few years remaining. I have only two wishes: to keep my family safe and to find Zhu Xinrou.”

Holding the black garment beside the coffin, Master Bai looked as though he had reached a decision. His voice dropped to a murmur. “Whether or not I find her, at least this coffin will serve a purpose.”

“Old master, don’t be that pessimistic. Now that we know the exact location of the burial site, we can report to the police tomorrow.”

Digging for a body would disturb the crime scene, so Chen Ge preferred to leave it to the police.

“That’s reasonable, but I want to check first. During the poisoning investigation, I told the police a body was buried in the orchard, yet they found nothing. I’m afraid something may go wrong again.”

The old man grabbed the lamp and the hoe.

“You have a point.”

The rain had weakened. Chen Ge collected his backpack and followed Master Bai to the largest tree in the center of the orchard. They dug around it for a long time without finding Zhu Xinrou’s body.

“That can’t be right.” Zhu Xinrou had no reason to deceive Chen Ge; he had only offered to help.

“Sigh, looks like it’s not here either.” There was a thick disappointment in the old man’s voice.

“Wait.” Chen Ge studied the decaying tree, drew the hammer from his bag, and struck its trunk. The slender trunk shuddered under the blow.

“The roots are dead; the trunk might be hollow.”

Together they loosened the soil around the roots and toppled the tree. Beneath the root ball lay a web-filled hollow, from which protruded what appeared to be a woman’s legs.

“This is it!”

Zhu Xinrou had been buried headfirst, with the peach tree planted over her body as a seal.

“Save me…”

When the body was found, Chen Ge’s black phone vibrated. He took several steps back to look at the message.

“Congratulations, Specter’s Favored! You’ve triggered the trial mission for a three-star scenario—Coffin Village! The scenario is extremely dangerous! Please decide whether to accept the mission within a week!”
